recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5155; any future wording polish to the section.code comment should be handled separately as editorial work.
issue_request: FHIR-5155 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Composition ballot issue asking to remove the invariant that allowed Composition.section.code only when the section had no content; the final resolution removed the constraint because FHIR does not have context conduction and section.code does not change nested or referenced resource meaning.
initial_application: SVN revision 4658, represented as git commit cdebd6f91d71248ac4eb50636dad18b4e4bf0dbc, removed the old Composition spreadsheet invariant and updated the section.code explanatory comment. Later source refactors carried that result into source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Composition.section constraints are cmp-1, cmp-2, and cmp-3, none of which forbids section.code with entries/content, and the section.code comment states that the code does not change the meaning or interpretation of the resource content. FHIR-5494 is the same old-invariant clarification trail, but Jira says it was superseded by FHIR-5155 and the combined branch already has a FHIR-5494 audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The empty audit commit records that current FHIR-core source already satisfies FHIR-5155.
